item.title: How to get Florence and the Machine tickets: How much are seats, dates, and prices
item.description: Florence and the Machine's highly anticipated tour is kicking off next year, and it's not too late to secure tickets.

item.title: Disney is betting OpenAI can help it solve a key problem
item.description: Disney faces an engagement problem as kids gravitate to YouTube. It's looking to OpenAI to help boost engagement.

item.title: Lululemon CEO Calvin McDonald is stepping down
item.description: Calvin McDonald, CEO of Lululemon, is stepping down at the end of January, the company said. The board is now searching for his replacement.

item.title: Costco is firing on all cylinders — and shoppers are loving it
item.description: Costco beat expectations with net sales of nearly $66 billion for its first fiscal quarter, including US comparable sales growth of 5.9%.

item.title: Trump signs executive order restricting states' ability to regulate AI
item.description: Trump has said that AI would be "destroyed in its infancy" if companies have to comply with 50 different sets of regulations.

item.title: Lululemon is dialing back the in-store clutter
item.description: The athleisure giant is finally making changes to its overcrowded, inventory-packed stores.

item.title: Canada is figuring out what to do with its stockpiles of US alcohol
item.description: At least four provinces will be using the sales of their American liquor to fund food banks and charities.

item.title: Uber CEO says robotaxis are a 'trillion-dollar-plus' business — and one market will drive the boom
item.description: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi says robotaxis are a "trillion-dollar-plus" business and he expects Asia to drive the wave of autonomous expansion.

item.title: What smart people are saying about Disney's licensing deal with OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI said Thursday it had struck a licensing agreement to use Disney's characters and other intellectual property.

item.title: Russia's wartime consumer boom is cracking as shoppers tighten their wallets
item.description: Russia saw a surge in consumer spending after its 2022 invasion of Ukraine, even as sweeping sanctions hit the economy.
